confirmed_current_contract.fact: Worker qualification v2/v3 already accepts1..128 sorted unique exact ASCII nonstdlib negative names, with bounded lengths, no wildcard, overlapping parent/child declarations or local-source overlap. All declared negatives are checked before entry. Every requested declared name first passes import guard rechecks, then require_absent_imports for that exact request. Only after successful absence checking is expected_denial set and ModuleNotFoundError(name=fullname) raised without poisoning.

Absence rechecks active custody, signals and full held namespaces. It refuses overlap with mapped modules/namespaces/exports/native-cache declarations and physical Python, extension, directory/namespace or bytecode alternatives in all held package roots; child names also require a registered parent package/namespace. This is held-forest proof, not arbitrary host filesystem absence.

Undeclared nonstdlib import failure poisons admission, retains first_failure, closes holders and restores prior import dispatch. A vendor catch does not reset admission. Already executing vendor frames can continue until another failure/boundary; poison is not synchronous termination.

The successful receipt records expected_missing_imports and a set of seen denied names. Parent and independent auditor require the exact registered roster and seen-name subset. It records neither counts, ordering nor requesting caller for each attempt, and does not claim all declared negatives were requested.
